description: A Flutter widget implementing an OTP validation and social login screen, including UI layout, button handlers, and testing bypass functionality.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: Main widget for OTP validation and social login, managing UI and user interactions.

classes.name: _OTPValidationScreenState
classes.description: State class handling the logic and UI state for OTPValidationScreen.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton
methods.description: Creates styled social login buttons for Google, Facebook, and Apple.

methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap bypass detection.

methods.description: Debug method to bypass login flow for testing purposes, navigates directly to HomeActivity.

methods.description: Validates phone input and navigates to OTPSecondScreen if valid.
